changes: New: Player status tiers — Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum/Diamond, combining the whole dashboard: Casino Lifetime XP, the betting board's own Season Score (P/L, win rates, volume), and cumulative Footy Tipping season points into one 'Prestige Score'. A bad run never subtracts — only good results add. Badge shows next to your name on the leaderboard, your profile, Hold'em seats, and table chat. Explained on the Badges view with your live breakdown.

Fixed: the win-streak feature was writing to a Firebase path with no rule allowing it — streaks were almost certainly never actually saving. Firebase rules updated to fix it, plus a new rule for the tier system's tipping-points cache (deploy firebase-rules.json for this).

Fixed: Hold'em tables created before creator-tracking existed (old test tables) could never show a Delete button for anyone. Those now delete for any signed-in member; properly-owned tables are unaffected. Admin-email check made case/whitespace-insensitive as a defensive fix.

Fixed: the real reason Roulette and Craps still capped at 250 XP on a single spot — the chip readout was tied only to the preset buttons, no way to enter more. Chips now stack by tapping (250 x4 = 1000 XP) on every Casino game, and a 5 XP chip was added to every chip rail across the Casino.
New: Win streaks — 3+ wins in a row across any single-player Casino game shows a flickering 🔥 flame badge next to your name on the leaderboard, plus a toast the moment you hit it.
New: Session recap — leaving a Casino game shows a quick card: hands played, net XP, biggest win.
New: Croupier table-talk — dealer-voice captions flash at the right moments on Roulette, Craps, and Blackjack (no more bets, come-out/point/seven-out, blackjack/bust/push, etc).
New: Blackjack, Baccarat, and Casino War all now have a 'last 10 outcomes' history strip, matching Roulette/Craps/Hold'em.
Fixed: Craps wins/losses were never feeding the Monthly Casino Pot — a gap in the reason-text pattern that detects a casino round.
New: Craps got Take Down / Let It Ride / Press for Place and Hardway wins — pay out and clear (default), leave the bet working, or add the win straight onto the bet.

New: full brass rail bezel treatment extended to Blackjack, Baccarat, Casino War, Video Poker, and Challenges' head-to-head hand view, matching Roulette/Craps/Hold'em. Craps' One-Roll Props got their own bordered panel with Any 7 as a red banner row.

New: Craps built as a full high-roller table — Pass Line, Don't Pass, Come, Don't Come, Field, Odds, Place, Hardways, Props — with a real 3D dice cube (2.1s tumble), casino chip-token bet display, and its own felt/rail table with MLSYND CASINO watermark.

Fixed: a real double-tap race across Casino — a fast double-tap on the main action button could debit a bet or claim a reward twice. Fixed on Blackjack (Deal/Double/Split), Casino War, Baccarat, Roulette, Daily Spin, and Challenges (Accept/Send).
Fixed: Hold'em's Stand Up and Sit Out buttons could silently fail to respond — a live-update redraw was yanking the button out from under a tap. Fixed at the root.

Fixed: Hold'em's own hand winner could see 'Spectating' in Your Cards at showdown despite everyone else seeing their cards. Showdown now shows a proper result banner with mini cards and a trophy on your own win; Recent Hands shows the same. Watermark is the actual MLSYND CASINO wordmark, Big Blind moved to a small bubble, in-table chat got real message bubbles.
Fixed: Tipping's background refresh could silently wipe a pick you'd tapped or a margin you'd typed but hadn't saved yet. It now pauses while you're typing, and unsaved picks survive the refresh.
Fixed: Home tab's individual bet amount now colors by actual Win/Loss result, not the sign of the dollar figure — a $0.00 loss shows red instead of green.
New: Lifetime XP shown on the Casino leaderboard and member profile cards. New: a Casino XP teaser on the Home tab with a quick Play button through.
Moved: Challenges and Hold'em live inside Games as regular game bubbles instead of separate hub tiles; each has its own distinct icon.

Casino: live-win flash ticker threshold raised 300→500 XP. Baccarat's Banker bet no longer takes a commission — pays 1:1, same as Player. Big Win popups show a visual of the actual hand or winning number when available.

Tipping: Rounds 0, 5, and 25-29 show their real names (Opening Round, Gather Round, Wildcard Finals, Qualifying/Elimination Round, Semi Finals, Preliminary Finals, Grand Final) everywhere a round appears.
Polish: the Sport dropdown, News dropdown, and Tipping's round selector match the app's real dark/brass input styling instead of plain browser defaults.

Ledger app: fixed the Bettor Rotation panel — winning a bet no longer auto-ticks the SGM checkbox (that's a separate, unrelated promo). A win now auto-adds a genuine second bet row instead, which correctly counts toward the tally. Hint text and a tooltip rewritten to explain the real rules (deploy LEDGER-index.html for this).
